info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Contracts Management API
info.description: The Workforce Contracts Management API provides essential capabilities for updating existing workforce contracts within the human resources domain. This API allows users to modify contract details for employees, ensuring compliance and alignment with organizational policies. Typical consumers include HR professionals and payroll systems that require real-time updates to contract terms. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can efficiently manage workforce agreements and promote better resource planning.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an existing workforce contract associated with a specific employee. Provide the required fields in the request body to make the necessary changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the workforce contract for the specified employee identified by 'EMP-900045'. Ensure that only the fields that need to be updated are included in the request body.

requestedBy.description: Identifier of the person requesting the changes.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication, which is a standard method for securing API requests. The access token must be provided in the Authorization header as a 'Bearer' token. The token format is JSON Web Token (JWT), which allows for the secure transmission of claims between parties.
